collections.name: Shower Threshold
collections.description:
Threshold for a perfect finish of the shower system

APPLICATIONS - Makes the junction between a floor covering and a shower covering - Compatible with floors 2 or 3.5mm thick BENEFITS - Weld system with the covering which ensures perfect watertightness - Allows welding of 2 or 3.5mm floor covering thanks to the tab system - 3 colours to limit the contrast PACKAGING - 10 units of 3 LM
